title: 静态链与动态链 / Static links vs dynamic links

checks.name: lexical scoping: r sees main's x
6 non-local accesses x 2 static hops, plus 1 hop to link q (called from p) to main
static link set to the caller -> r silently reads p's x
non-local access walks the dynamic chain -> same silent bug
one hop too few -> lands in q, which has no x

link-to-caller.reason: wrong: point every static link at the caller's AR
link-to-caller.explain: 把静态链当成动态链用：p 调 q 时，q 的静态链指向了 p 而不是 main，于是 r 找到的是 p 的 x。

access-dynamic-chain.reason: wrong: resolve non-local names along callers (dynamic scoping)
access-dynamic-chain.explain: 沿调用者（动态链）找非局部变量，相当于动态作用域；结果取决于谁调用了 q。

access-off-by-one.reason: wrong: one static hop too few
access-off-by-one.explain: 层差算少了一层：r 在第 3 层，x 声明在第 1 层，应走 2 跳。
